summary: Frontend billing logic testing for web app. Verified billing API returns billing_enabled=true and web_billing_enabled=true. Found critical bugs: (1) Guest skip limit not enforced - incrementGuestSkipCount() defined but never called, (2) Subscription status endpoint returns 'User not found' for valid users due to collection mismatch, (3) Billing check timing issue - user state not propagated when billing check runs.

critical.issue: Returns 'User not found' for valid users. Endpoint looks in 'app_users' collection but users exist in 'users' collection. This breaks the isPremium check for logged-in users.

integration_issues.issue: incrementGuestSkipCount() function is defined (line 4146) but NEVER called. Guest users can skip unlimited times without seeing GuestLimitModal.
handleSkipWithBillingCheck only checks for logged-in non-premium users (line 4492: if (user && billingEnabled && !isPremium)). Guest users bypass all billing checks.
Billing check runs before user state is fully propagated. Console shows 'user_logged_in: false' even when user is visually logged in. This causes isPremium to be incorrectly set.

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: Add incrementGuestSkipCount() call in handleSkipWithBillingCheck for guest users (when !user)
FIX CRITICAL: Fix /api/user/subscription-status endpoint to look in correct collection ('users' not 'app_users')
FIX HIGH: Add guest skip limit check in handleSkipWithBillingCheck - should call incrementGuestSkipCount() and show GuestLimitModal after 3 skips
FIX HIGH: Ensure billing status check waits for user state to be fully loaded before determining isPremium
critical_code_review_comments: Line 4146: incrementGuestSkipCount() is defined but never called anywhere in the codebase
Line 4490-4506: handleSkipWithBillingCheck only handles logged-in users, guest users bypass all checks
Line 294 in monetization.py: Endpoint queries 'app_users' collection but users are stored in 'users' collection
Line 3622: Billing check uses 'token && user?.user_id' but user state may not be set yet

success_rate.frontend: 40% - Billing API works, but billing triggers not functioning correctly

context_for_next_testing_agent: Billing logic has critical bugs. The SubscriptionRequiredModal and GuestLimitModal components exist but are not being triggered correctly. Key issues: (1) Guest skip limit not enforced, (2) Backend subscription-status endpoint broken, (3) User state timing issue. Test after fixes by: logging in as non-premium user, playing a song, skipping 3 times - should see SubscriptionRequiredModal. For guests, skip 3 times - should see GuestLimitModal.
